verdicts.reason: A is unusable: the headline is white text on a white canvas, so it is invisible apart from stray fragments. The forest image is a small central strip, and the subhead and body copy are cut off at its edge. B is just the original shrunk into the middle of the banner. It leaves huge white dead zones on both sides, the body copy is illegibly tiny, and nothing has been rearranged for the wide format. Still, B is intact and on brand, so it is the less bad of the two.
